## Problem and behavior
Describe the trigger and before/after behavior.

## Validation
- [ ] Include a synthetic reproduction, failure path and passing control.
- [ ] Run build, typecheck, lint and relevant tests.
- [ ] Update public contracts and documentation for behavior changes.
- [ ] Exclude credentials, real personal data and sensitive logs.
- [ ] Describe compatibility and cancellation/observation risks.
- [ ] Route security details privately; see SECURITY.md (route pending).
